description: The plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and Average Lagging (AL) for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) on a linear scale, with values ranging from approximately -1 to 11, and features tick marks at intervals of 2.5 from 0.0 to 10.0. The y-axis represents BLEU on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 17.5 to 29.5, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at intervals of 2 from 18 to 28. The Consistency-CE method is represented by a light purple dashed line with circle markers, starting at an AL of approximately 0.2 with a BLEU score of 18.8 and ending at an AL of 3.0 with a BLEU score of 22.9. The Inconsistency-CE method is shown as a dark purple solid line with square markers, beginning at x ≈ 0.1, y ≈ 20.1, steadily increasing through points such as x ≈ 4.8, y ≈ 24.5, and ending at x ≈ 9.9, y ≈ 27.1. The Inconsistency-CE-MP method is depicted by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at the lowest x-value of approximately -0.9 with a y-value of 18.5, rising steadily through x ≈ 4.5, y ≈ 24.6, and concluding at x ≈ 9.8, y ≈ 27.2. Finally, the Consistency-Bi method is illustrated by a red solid line with star markers, starting at x ≈ 0.8, y ≈ 22.5, increasing to a peak at x ≈ 8.3, y ≈ 28.8, before slightly declining to end at x ≈ 10.5, y ≈ 28.5.
